description: Phase 4 MerLin adaptation on reduced ZINC (claim C1): GRIT with RRWP plus the two-photon threshold-detection walk encoding, four seeds, 200 of 2000 epochs, same protocol as zinc_reduced.json. Compared with the Phase 3 candidates through zinc_photonic_comparison.json. Results are partial.
checkpoint_rule: model with the lowest validation MAE over the 200 epochs, evaluated once on the test split
aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over the four seeds
tie_rule: no winner unless the margin exceeds twice the larger seed standard deviation and a Wilcoxon signed-rank test on seed-averaged per-graph absolute errors gives p < 0.05
selection_rule: none: one fixed configuration, no candidate is selected
